In the center foreground, a girl with pink hair leans against a railing, smiling. Behind her, a boy in a yellow shirt points toward the sky. The dancer in purple spins while their partner in grey holds their hand. On the far right edge, a bartender in a black apron pours a drink into a tall glass. A silver ice bucket rests next to the bartender on the counter. A small bird flies near the moon in the upper right corner. There is no rain falling from the sky.
